MEET THE ARTIST / 화이트유즈드삭스

WhiteUsedSocks

WhiteUsedSocks are a Korean rock band who began releasing music in 2017. Expressive vocals and emotional lyrics sit at the heart of their songs, including the early single “Don’t feel sad”.

ROCK / 2017

Don’t feel sad

Official audio

View release on Apple Music ↗

Written and composed by Jung Jaeheon, “Don’t feel sad” was released in June 2017. It belongs to the early part of WhiteUsedSocks’ catalogue, before releases such as The Little Match Boy and Through Yearning.

Listening note

The band’s official release page credits Jung Jaeheon as both lyricist and composer. The 2017 date here refers to the original release, rather than a later digital catalogue entry.
